cohort: A 9-year-old boy who presented with progressive weight gain and obesity, and later developed diabetes.
finding: The ABCC8 c.4613G>A (p.Arg1538Gln) variant, previously associated with congenital hyperinsulinism, can also present as Maturity-Onset Diabetes of the Young (MODY) without prior CHI, expanding its phenotypic spectrum.
